limitations: The oracle uses a hand-authored four-node graph and a five-span trace; it is not representative of production workloads.
Uncertainty metadata is synthetic and describes what the local evaluator knows about sampling and clocks; it does not reconstruct omitted production spans.
Explicit span bindings are supplied by the fixture, so binding discovery quality is outside this evaluation.
samplingCaveats: A missing span is retained as an observation gap and never treated as evidence that the corresponding behavior is absent.
A missing parent creates an explicit unmodeled record for the retained child; it does not silently repair the trace or infer a static edge.
Sampling rates describe this synthetic trace only and are not population estimates.

cases.description: Complete trace with exact trace-clock ordering and service aliases recorded as metadata only.

sampling.rationale: All five synthetic spans were retained; completeness is scoped to this fixture.

confidencePolicy.certainWhen: Every referenced span has a certain explicit binding and the trace clock is exact.
confidencePolicy.inferredWhen: A binding is inferred, an endpoint is ambiguous, or clock precision downgrades an otherwise certain observation.
confidencePolicy.unknownWhen: A modeled edge has no retained trace evidence or a referenced parent/binding is missing.
